  "v_stage_conversion"
  "v_time_to_hire"
  "v_top_jobs"
)

for table in "${tables[@]}"; do
  echo ""
  echo "TABLE: $table"
  
  # Find files with this table
  files=$(grep -r "\.from(\"$table\"\|\.from('$table'" --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" src/ app/ 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '{print $1}' | sort -u)
  
  if [ -z "$files" ]; then
    echo "  Files: (none found)"
    continue
  fi
  
  echo "  Files:"
  echo "$files" | while read -r file; do
    echo "    - $file"
  done
  
  # Check for write operations
  write_ops=$(grep -r "\.from(\"$table\"\|\.from('$table'" --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" src/ app/ 2>/dev/null | grep -E "(\.insert|\.update|\.delete|\.upsert)" | wc -l)
  
  # Check for read operations
  read_ops=$(grep -r "\.from(\"$table\"\|\.from('$table'" --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" src/ app/ 2>/dev/null | grep -E "\.select" | wc -l)
  
  if [ $write_ops -gt 0 ] && [ $read_ops -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "  Operations: READ & WRITE"
  elif [ $write_ops -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "  Operations: WRITE"
  elif [ $read_ops -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "  Operations: READ"
  else
    echo "  Operations: UNKNOWN (may be used in other ways)"
  fi
done
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/table_mapping.sh
